extraction.method: Read exact named stackup sections from archived server-rendered HTML. Inspect table-tr text in the matching li, not the generic Markdown rendering, which omitted the div-based construction rows.

constructions.name: JLC06161H-3313
constructions.literal_core_note: 0.55mm H/Hwithout copper, repeated for both cores

limits: The displayed copper/dielectric sums are not exactly1.6mm. Do not alter the published values to force a match or treat either sum as qualified finished thickness.
The cited rows do not establish a complete tolerance, frequency-specific Dk/Df or laminate-grade model.
Use the supplier-confirmed construction and finished-thickness/process definition before final fabrication or impedance acceptance.

engineering_implications.four_layer: F over In1 protected GND has a close reference. The lower internal layer is separated from In1 by the1.265mm core; B routing cannot assume a continuous reference if that lower layer carries split power/signals.
engineering_implications.six_layer: The thin central0.1088mm dielectric is between L3 and L4. L3-to-L2 and L4-to-L5 separations are each0.55mm. Simply labeling both central layers SIGNAL does not provide each a nearby solid ground plane.
engineering_implications.illustrative_six_layer_tradeoff: S/G/S/G/G/S gives three signal layers with close references at the three thin dielectric gaps; S/G/S/S/G/S gives four signal layers but requires separate inner-signal reference/coupling review. These are engineering alternatives, not selected input profiles or demonstrated Quilter capabilities.
engineering_implications.root_disposition: Retain the two named constructions as comparison candidates, not approved stackups. Select and verify explicit layer purposes before counting useful routing layers or predicting routing/compute benefit.

mandatory_process_screen.process: Nonconductive epoxy resin fill, surface leveling/planarization and copper cap; no tenting, mask plugging or conductive-paste substitution.
mandatory_process_screen.four_layer_policy: POFV is documented as available with an additional charge; amount and exact-package eligibility are not established.
mandatory_process_screen.six_layer_policy: The international-market article documents POFV included for6-20 layers; this is not a delivered-board or assembly quote.
remaining_conditions: The article says more than0.45mm from regular PTH/NPTH; the diagram labels clearance>=0.45mm. The measurement boundary and exact board hole-clearance screen remain unresolved here; do not infer center-to-center distance.

The via-covering quality table mentions surface copper>=5um and depression/protrusion wording of127um/50um; the separate POFV article advertises up to25um. Do not turn that advertised upper value into a guaranteed minimum or silently declare planarity qualified.
Exact filled-via selection, cap/planarity acceptance, component-hole spacing and supplier manufacturing review remain gates.
A source-size/ring screen does not waive the previously observed returned-project0.15mm annular rule or authorize resizing protected vias.

quilter_binding.documented: A correctly configured/detected input stackup and design minimums can be selected at the top of the Stackups step. Quilter documents writing its used stackup into returned native files.
quilter_binding.name_requirement: Documentation asks for ground/gnd names for ground layers and power/pwr for power layers. Supply those naming hints, then verify actual imported purpose and material fields; names alone are not proof.
quilter_binding.observed_old_preset_not_equivalent: Earlier saved JLCPCB4-Layer UI showed dielectric0.21/1.065/0.21mm, not this3313 construction's0.0994/1.265/0.0994mm.
quilter_binding.unqualified: Neither input-defined candidate has been encoded, imported or selected. Exact material/role/minimum detection must be demonstrated; a generic supplier/layer-count label is insufficient.

next_dependency: Conservative source-bound process-hole clearance assessment and explicit layer-purpose disposition, while the separate native guard behavior gate remains held.
